results.description: 2.1: Wrong recipient must never receive the message (strict resolution)
2.2: Ambiguous contact selection must stop for clarification
2.3: The exact message must be previewed before dispatch
2.4: No message can be dispatched without explicit user approval
2.5: Minimized window must not cause incorrect coordinate targeting (relative composer targeting)
2.6: A failed or inconclusive send must not be reported as delivered
2.7: Emergency Stop must prevent dispatch if activated before sending
2.8: Distinguishes DRAFTED, APPROVED, DISPATCHED, DELIVERED, FAILED, and UNVERIFIED
3.1 (Boundary A): Recovery before irreversible action is safe to execute
3.2 (Boundary B): Crash during irreversible action records uncertainty and requests user intervention
3.3 (Boundary C): External state inspector confirms dispatch without duplicate send
3.4 (Boundary D): Crash after recording result resumes at independent verification
3.5 (Boundary E): Crash after verification completes node persistence without duplicate re-run
3.6: A timeout is NEVER interpreted as proof an action did not happen
4.1: Corrupted checkpoint handling quarantines file and avoids crash loop
4.2: Duplicate worker prevention rejects secondary concurrent execution of same task
4.3: Stale task detection identifies abandoned running tasks
4.4: Restart preserves completed nodes and resumes downstream dependent nodes
5.1: Approval token expires when TTL elapses
5.2: Modifying arguments after approval fails cryptographic validation
5.3: Single-use token consumption prevents replay attacks
5.4: Tool substitution using another tools token is strictly rejected
5.5: Cross-task token reuse is rejected when bound to a specific taskId
5.6: No agent or model may approve its own privileged operation
5.7: Emergency latch persists to disk and remains latched across re-instantiation
6.1: Real window visibility and process query independent of model claim
6.2: Mathematical calculations verified against analytical ground truth (Beam Bending)
6.3: Inconclusive or missing evidence strictly reports UNVERIFIED
6.4: Spreadsheet verification validates real row counts and non-empty byte count
6.5: Code execution verified via exit code and stdout assertion
